newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe, Pacific Iridium sign roaming pact.
newsitem.headline: Globe, Pacific Iridium sign roaming pact.

text.p: The Philippines' Globe Telecom has signed a cellular roaming agreement with Taiwan-based Pacific Iridium Telecommunications Co Ltd, a joint statement said on Tuesday.
Pacific uses the Iridium system, a satellite-based, wireless personal communication network that gives its subscriber a single worldwide number and one bill.
The agreement will allow future Iridium cellular mobile phone subscribers access to Globe's network as well as global roaming capability.

A Filipino Iridium user travelling to the United States, for instance, would be able to use the same telephone and phone number, access the local cellular network of the service providers that have roaming agreements with Iridium, or directly access the Iridium satellite in areas where there is no existing terrestrial wireless coverage.
Pacific has been authorised by Delaware-based Iridium LLC to provide satellite cellular mobile services in Taiwan, Indonesia, Brunei, Papua New Guinea, Brunei and the Philippines.

Globe, a joint venture of Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd, said it plans to offer Iridium service in the Philippines once its application is approved by the National Telecommunications Commission.
